headline: Launcher 0.7.0 plays the US disc and introduces save editing
summary: OpenRAC released launcher 0.7.0 with US-disc play and a Ratchet & Clank save editor. Initial US-disc checks cover Veldin and direct starts on Novalis and Kerwan, rather than a complete campaign. Going Commando's refreshed USA v1.01 report raises matched code from 5.75% to 6.51%, including original handwritten assembly in its finished totals. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
